evals.prompt: /research-url "look into browser-harness for my tooling repos"

evals.prompt: /research-url "This newsletter lists Tool A, Tool B, and Tool C: https://example.com/ai-weekly"

expectations: Classifies the URL as an aggregator/newsletter before fit assessment
Fetches underlying sources for substantive items instead of relying on blurbs
Caps aggregator follow-up to the highest-signal items
Treats zero filed tasks as valid when no item clears the evidence bar
